content.text: Sentinel monitors a primary/replica setup and performs automatic failover when the primary fails. It is simpler than Cluster.

content.code:
sentinel monitor mymaster 127.0.0.1 6379 2
sentinel down-after-milliseconds mymaster 5000
sentinel failover-timeout mymaster 60000

content.text: Cluster provides both high availability and sharding across up to 1000 nodes using 16384 hash slots.

content.code:
# Check cluster health
redis-cli cluster info
redis-cli cluster nodes

questions.question: What is Redis Sentinel used for?
questions.explanation: Sentinel monitors Redis instances and automatically promotes a replica if the primary fails.

faq.q: Should I use Sentinel or Cluster?
faq.a: Use Sentinel for HA without sharding (simpler). Use Cluster when you need horizontal scale across many nodes.
